searchText: <@!552133098075193354> The storm we are in is likely to turn to ice in a few hours and quite possibly -- like last year -- pull down power and internet with it. If it's an option, is there a way to telephone into the meeting? DM’d you the info! <@!552133098075193354> It would be quite helpful if the agenda line items that reference an EIP also include the EIP titles, not just the numbers. Noted, <@!301186049323958275> 👍 On that note 🙂 **AllCoreDevs in ~25 minutes (14:00UTC)** Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/459 Stream: https://youtu.be/_kt-r4J8PJc Zoom: https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/91348592283?pwd=SnRnL1VTeXNYVE9CaWpBbnJEUXhQZz09 In retrospect having a tiny Shanghai instead of Arrow Glacier would have been nice to crank out those simple EIPs. It feels like with Shanghai planned for later this year and the breadth of proposals just means it will be impossible to ever get up to speed, i.e. everything will get pushed out again. I really feel like we need to get to a place where we can improve different parts of the protocol in parallel Absolutely, though most of these proposals affect many parts at the same time. evm, transactions (p2p), storage re: <@!489256758989029405> suggestion, is two calls every two weeks too big of an ask for execution teams? (one for EIPs and one for Merge) i do echo tim in that it might just be the same people anyways, but maybe these things need more time I suspect there will be *some* people who show up to both calls, but not everyone will I think. I also think we just need more regular cross-team communication in general and we don't seem to be getting much of that via Discord. 😖 We already have two calls every week now: CL call + ACD Yes, and I'm also a biit skeptical of adding more calls when we don't constantly go overtime in our current ones...! That suggests to me that we do need more calls, we have more to talk about than we are allowing ourselves time to talk about. > We already have two calls every week now: CL call + ACD To what extent does the CL call already overlap with CL portions of the ACD call? Would it suffice to just shift more of the CL aspects of ACD call to the CL call? Both calls cover the merge in the first half <dankrad> it feels like CL call could take the role of the merge call until the merge? But why remove merge stuff from the EL call? The discussion today was super valuable I think it’s really good that our iteration cycle on merge stuff is weekly vs biweekly right now. I guess I disagree that we need more EL non-merge time urgently Especially, more scheduled in advance, recurring, non merge EL time. We can of course do a bunch of ad hoc calls which are focused on individual topics. And I’m also very mindful of keeping as much of our focus on the merge as possible until it’s actually done. IMO the constraints on time/attention for non merge things right now are a net positive. PR for the CFI Shanghai EIPs. Can someone sanity check before I merge 😄 ? https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/447 cc: <@!425279588009246720> Left a comment Good point, I'm actually unsure whether EIP-3855 (PUSH0) was also part of the ones we're moving to CFI. On the last ACD the three others were discussed, but today we grouped 3855 with them during conversations. Tagged client devs who were involved in the conversation on the call today so we can ideally merge this before the next ACD I think some client devs expressed interest on the call, but more importantly Solidity did as it would help the optimiser/codegen. Not sure who manages the DMs, but I just got a message purportedly from <@!275684146658148352> that looks like dangerous spam. Yes he was compromised Today ACD was top quality. What people say. Packed with goodies. Got a +1 from all client teams on 3855. Adding to the spec.

excerpts.content: In retrospect having a tiny Shanghai instead of Arrow Glacier would have been nice to crank out those simple EIPs.
